title: Upload a recording you already have

say: Already have a call recording? Here's how to get its Report.
पहले से call की recording है? उसका Report ऐसे पाइए.
caption: Pehle se call ki recording hai? Uska Report aise paaiye.

say: आधीच call ची recording आहे? त्याचा Report असा मिळवा.
caption: Aadhich call chi recording aahe? Tyacha Report asa milva.

say: Tap plus, then Add a call. On a computer, it's New analysis.
Plus दबाइए, फिर Add a call. Computer पे ये New analysis है.
caption: Plus dabaiye, phir Add a call. Computer pe yeh New analysis hai.

say: Plus दाबा, मग Add a call. Computer वर हे New analysis आहे.
caption: Plus daba, mag Add a call. Computer var he New analysis aahe.

say: Choose the recording from your phone or computer.
Most formats work, even your phone recorder's own files.
अपने phone या computer से recording चुनिए.
ज़्यादातर formats चलते हैं, phone recorder की files भी.
caption: Apne phone ya computer se recording chuniye.
Zyaadatar formats chalte hain, phone recorder ki files bhi.

say: तुमच्या phone किंवा computer मधून recording निवडा.
बहुतेक formats चालतात, phone recorder च्या files पण.
caption: Tumchya phone kinva computer madhun recording nivda.
Bahutek formats chaltat, phone recorder chya files pan.

say: Pick the Report's language, agree to the terms once, and tap Analyse my call.
Report की language चुनिए, एक बार terms से agree कीजिए, और Analyse my call दबाइए.
caption: Report ki language chuniye, ek baar terms se agree kijiye, aur Analyse my call dabaiye.

say: Report ची language निवडा, एकदा terms ला agree करा, आणि Analyse my call दाबा.
caption: Report chi language nivda, ekda terms la agree kara, aani Analyse my call daba.

say: Sales X-Ray listens to the call and prepares your Report.
You can leave the page. The Report waits for you in Calls.
Sales X-Ray call सुनता है और आपका Report तैयार करता है.
आप page छोड़ सकते हैं. Report Calls में आपका इंतज़ार करेगा.
caption: Sales X-Ray call sunta hai aur aapka Report taiyaar karta hai.
Aap page chhod sakte hain. Report Calls mein aapka intezaar karega.

say: Sales X-Ray call ऐकतो आणि तुमचा Report तयार करतो.
तुम्ही page सोडू शकता. Report Calls मध्ये तुमची वाट बघेल.
caption: Sales X-Ray call aikto aani tumcha Report tayar karto.
Tumhi page sodu shakta. Report Calls madhye tumchi vaat baghel.
